name: memorizz
description: Durable, searchable project memory for Codex, plus your saved MemoRizz agents, through MemoRizz's MCP server.

interface.longDescription: MemoRizz gives Codex a durable memory that outlasts sessions: it recalls this project's facts, decisions and preferences when a session starts, searches them on request, and saves new ones you or Codex decide to keep. Memories live in your MemoRizz store (files by default, or MongoDB/Oracle), where the MemoRizz UI, CLI and your other agents can see them too. It can also consult your saved MemoRizz agents.
defaultPrompt: What do you remember about this project?
Remember that we run tests with pytest -n 8.
Search memory for how we deploy this service.
